description: Plan v7 section 8.3 fixture family 'm3b-region-slot'. Inputs only; the oracle emits expected.

cases.notes: CldrLocaleData$TagParts.isRegionSubtag:711, the arm where a TWO-CHARACTER subtag fails the alphabetic test and therefore does NOT take the region slot. Because the region slot stays empty, aliasLanguageTagOnce:297 adopts prs's alias region AF and the canonical form is fa-AF-1a, whose CLDR chain is [fa-AF, fa] -- so the fa-AF catalog is selected. A port whose isRegionSubtag accepted any two-character subtag puts 1A in the region slot, refuses AF at 297, canonicalizes to fa-1A whose chain is [fa], and serves the fa catalog instead: a different translation with no error. Must use languageRanges, not locale: java.util.Locale.forLanguageTag('prs-1a') discards the subtag before the library is entered.

The discriminating partner: the same shape with an ALPHABETIC two-character subtag, which DOES take the region slot, so 297 refuses the alias's AF and the canonical form is fa-GB, whose chain is [fa-GB, fa] -- the fa catalog. The two rows differ in one character class and must select DIFFERENT catalogs; a port that slots every two-character subtag as a region collapses them onto fa, and a port that slots none as a region collapses them onto fa-AF.
